name: BoldHeader
description: Make the first row bold and centered.

name: FormatAsCurrency
description: Format a numeric column to show as currency.

name: FreezeTopRow
description: Freeze the first row so it stays visible.

name: HighlightNegatives
description: Apply conditional formatting so negative numbers show in red.

name: InsertColumns
description: Insert new columns after a chosen position.

name: AddTotalRow
description: Insert a totals row at the bottom, summing or averaging a column.

name: SortByColumn
description: Sort the sheet by one column ascending or descending.

name: CreatePivot
description: Build a pivot table from the data to summarize values.

name: CreateBarChart
description: Add a bar chart from a given range or pivot.

name: AddTrendline
description: Add a line chart to show trends over time.

name: ProtectHeaders
description: Lock the header row so it cannot be edited.

name: UndoLastChange
description: Revert the last action applied to the sheet.

name: UnboldHeader
description: Remove bold formatting from the header row.
